title: Frontend Intent v1
description: Canonical frontend-to-backend intent contract. Every intent carries trace_id, mutation_class, capability_required, and auth_required so the bridge and backend can govern before dispatch. Content-light: intent parameters are hashed, not stored raw.

message_id.description: Bridge envelope message_id that wraps this intent.

trace_id.description: End-to-end trace identifier surviving frontend -> bridge -> backend -> projection.

intent_id.description: Unique identifier for this intent request.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of intent creation.

intent_kind.description: Canonical intent name (e.g., refresh_projection, run_validation_suite, checkpoint.commit).

intent_payload_hash.description: Content-light hash of intent parameters. Raw parameters never cross the bridge unhashed.

mutation_class.description: Mutation safety class for this intent.

capability_required.description: Capability flags required to execute this intent.

auth_required.description: Whether this intent requires explicit authorization.

receipt_required.description: Whether this intent requires a receipt-backed evidence trail.

projection_patch_required.description: Whether this intent must produce a projection patch after completion.

dry_run.description: When true, intent is simulated and must not produce side effects.

authorization_receipt.description: Step-up authorization receipt for protected intents. Content-light: no raw tokens.

redaction_status.description: Hard invariant: every intent payload is content_light.
